relations.myth: Regeneration of maize and the Fifth Sun
relations.note: Modern scholarship links them symbolically; no continuous early narrative joins them.
Xipe's sacrificial cult nourished or reenacted solar warfare through captive combat.
Tláloc's rain rites surrounded Xipe's festival, whose hymn invokes water and rain.
Regional sources identify or compare Xipe and Red Tezcatlipoca with Camaxtli.
